definitions.ask: Where should the relocated legacy tree (formerly ~/Sync) live?

choices.label: ~/legacy: names it as the pre-chezmoi legacy tree; $DB is repointed at it

definitions.why: ~/.profile already calls this root $DB, and a ~/ sibling makes link retargets one-component swaps

definitions.ask: Should the ~70 stow-style dotfile symlinks into the tree become real files in ~?

choices.label: No: keep them as symlinks retargeted into the tree (pure rename, lowest risk)
Yes: move each linked file into ~ and rewrite its references; more invasive

definitions.why: a pure rename fixes everything with one verifiable substitution; de-stowing can come later

definitions.ask: Should all ~400 Syncthing *.sync-conflict-* files under ~ (2020-2022) be deleted?

choices.label: Yes: delete after writing a manifest; copies remain in hercules monthly/yearly backups
No: keep them (links retargeted); only markers, config, and the package are removed

definitions.why: they are Syncthing artifacts by definition, years stale, and still recoverable from hercules

definitions.ask: Should the old 33 GB ~/tmp contents (reachable only via ~/bar) move to ~/tmp/old_tmp?

choices.label: Yes: move them to ~/tmp/old_tmp and delete ~/bar, as the Oct 9 history attempted
No: leave them inside the relocated tree and just delete the ~/bar link

definitions.why: zsh history shows `mv ~/old_tmp ~/tmp/` on Oct 9 and `ls ~/tmp/old_tmp` on Oct 12
